position_in_lineage: After February Demiurge checkpoints and before the April 18 YaKSA numeric-runaway event.

physarum_network.description: Tero-Nakagaki-inspired conductance network with pressure/flow solve, conductance reinforcement and decay; file states it is intended for shortest-path/optimization-style search.
physarum_network.guard: Archive implementation is heuristic/finite code and is not treated as a universal proven shortest-path oracle.

physarum_swarm.description: Jeff-Jones-inspired particle swarm senses attractant plus trail gradients, deposits trail and evaporates weak trail.

mechanism: intent: shrink the solution graph / crystallize strongest links
physarum_contract.interpretation: This is a direct pre-BH implementation of the user's remembered rule that Physarum responds strongly to compression by narrowing sensing and deleting weak paths faster.

facts: EvolutionaryMemory contains G, light_beacons and space_curvature.
new record configurations become protective_field centers with protection_radius.
memory.py implements _gravitational_distance() and uses it around the protective field.
record events shrink active search ranges around the winning configuration.
check_revert() can return the best cold configuration when current score falls below revert_threshold under hot/unstable conditions.
core.py applies this as 'Tachyon rewind: откат к холодному состоянию'.
trainer.py replaces NaN/Inf logits, clamps logits, nan_to_num() repairs shifted logits/probabilities, clips gradients, and aborts a train pass if NaN gradient norms remain.
core.py instantiates PhysarumOptimizer(memory, n_particles=50, width=100, height=100).
Physarum periodically proposes candidate configurations from evolutionary memory.
thermal_eff is passed into Physarum, coupling thermal/stability state to compression behavior.

contract_edge_case_probe.finding: Repeated CONTRACT can raise evaporation above 1.0 because no upper clamp exists. Since evaporate() multiplies trail by (1-evaporation), the third repeated contraction can invert trail sign. This is a real implementation hazard and a useful historical event-horizon negative control.
contract_edge_case_probe.repair_rule_for_modern_lift: Clamp evaporation to [0, 1-epsilon] or use a monotone bounded decay parametrization before importing this mechanism into BH-Q2.1.
